name: tap-target-floor
note: Issue #311: every interactive control on every tab must clear the 44px tap-target floor at the phone viewport. The Library key/genre filter chips shipped at 30px because the floor was applied surface-by-surface (.keyModes, .keySoloScale, #catChips each carried a copy) while the .chip PRIMITIVE had none - so any chip row nobody remembered was under it. Compose's control bar separately SHRANK .iconBtn to 36x42 to buy horizontal room, which is the one budget line a tap target never funds. Red-first: pre-fix this fails on the Library tab with 24 sub-floor chips. MEASURED WITH offsetWidth/offsetHeight, NOT getBoundingClientRect - the rect is the transformed box and .chip:active carries scale(.94), so a compliant 44px chip reads 41.4px mid-press and the gate would cry wolf (see rules/mobile-ui-lessons.md reflex 9).
